acceptanceCriteria: A 1.0.0-rc.2 candidate built from a main carrying decision 0427's context changes has retained install-lifecycle qualification on at least darwin/arm64 and linux/amd64.

benchmarks/untouched-repository-v1/harness.py run executes once each against spf13/cobra (pin adbc8813) and Corvint (loop target a5a7412c) with the sealed preregistrations; run files and receipts are committed whatever the verdict.
README's Core jobs row and docs/RELEASE-NOTES.md state the three job verdicts from those runs, and V1-0019, V1-0431 and V1-0433 are closed or re-scoped from the result.
body: Decision 0427 / docs/build-log/2026-10-01-unproven-rows-root-causes.md. The go-chi/chi orientation corpus (development since decision 0425) scores 0 treatment-only critical misses over 20 cases with the rank-relative counterpart rule (TCP-V0-004) and the default anchor field (TCP-V0-022), against 4 on main and 3 at rc.1. The V1-0432/V1-0433 harness and loop-target fixes are on main. Row 3 of README's status table changes only to what the sealed cobra and Corvint runs report. The cobra and Corvint preregistrations target 1.0.0-rc.2 with harness b67cc95a; the candidate must be a verified release-artifact directory whose --version reads Corvint 1.0.0-rc.2.
title: Build 1.0.0-rc.2 and run the untouched-repository Core jobs on cobra and Corvint
